title: quantitativeeasing.eth | debtceiling.eth
tagline: A conceptual artwork diptych creating new token pairs (ETH/QE | BTC/USDEBT).
description:
This project is a conceptual artwork that intends to create a relationship between Ethereum's market cap and the Federal Reserve balance sheet. 

This project is a conceptual artwork that intends to create a relationship between Bitcoin's market cap and the United States debt ceiling.
how_its_made: This project leverages IPFS and ENS to create decentralized websites that doubles as NFTs listed on Open sea as the total Federal Reserve balance sheet priced in ETH and the US debt ceiling priced in Dollars.
